Enrollment123 | https://e123insurtech.com | Staff Platform Engineer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time

We are SaaS platform that connects Insurance Carriers, Agencies and Agents, and enables sales to consumers.

My team is hiring a Staff Platform Engineer to keep things running smoothly and help our engineers modernize and build new products.

We are responsible for:

    - security for PCI and HIPAA data
    - AWS infrastructure that serves millions of people every month
    - developer tools and infrastructure to allow our teams to deliver
    - data engineering and operational support
    - automation, monitoring, and on-call rotations (especially during Open Enrollment!)
Our stacks include:

    (70% --) SQL Server + ColdFusion
    (25% ++) Postgres + node/typescript
    (5%) Airflow + python
It's not a flashy product or stack I'll admit, but we have a lot of opportunities to improve the product and a lot of growth potential to expand our impact. Happy to tell you more!

If you're interested, email me at jjay+orangesite@enrollment123.com with your honest, hand-written resume. I don't want some super polished AI bullshit, show me your real experience! The interview process is hopefully short and sweet: 1) meet with me for a quick intro to ensure we'll be a good mutual fit, 2) advance to a technical interview with the team, then 3) a last culture + company info session so you have all the info to make a decision.

Sorry, given our industry and size, you must be in the US and able to work without visa sponsorship.
